title: How to use AI ethically, with Nathanael Fast, PhD

sentences.en: One of the big issues that I see with artificial intelligence is that we're building these powerful AI systems that are shaping the world.
sentences.zh: 我认为人工智能带来的一个重大问题是，我们正在构建这些塑造世界的强大人工智能系统。

sentences.en: And they're influencing the future for everyone who lives in the world, but also everyone who will live in the future.
sentences.zh: 它们正在影响着世界上每个人的未来，也影响着未来生活在这个世界上的每一个人的未来。

sentences.en: But they're being created by a tiny minority of the world population.
sentences.zh: 但它们却是由世界人口中极少数的一群人所创造的。

sentences.en: So very small number of people in a room, you know, building these AI systeMs.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，房间里极少数的人在构建这些人工智能系统。

sentences.en: And one of the problems that emerges when with that kind of relationship is that sometimes the benefits and the harms of the AI systems that we're building are unevenly distributed.
sentences.zh: 在这种关系下浮现的问题之一是，有时我们构建的人工智能系统所带来的益处和危害在人群中的分布是不均衡的。

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学话语》播客。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: We're doing something a little bit different this week.
sentences.zh: 本周我们将做一些略有不同的内容。

sentences.en: In early January, the American Psychological Association joined the Consumer Technology Association at CES, the world's largest technology trade show,
sentences.zh: 在一月初，美国心理学协会与消费技术协会一同参加了世界最大的科技贸易展——CES（国际消费电子展），

sentences.en: for a series of discussions about how technology is shaping human behavior and about how psychological science can help the development of more ethical and effective technology.
sentences.zh: 并参与了一系列讨论，探讨技术如何塑造人类行为，以及心理学科学如何助力开发出更具道德和成效的技术。

sentences.en: Amid the robots, gaming systems, smart tech, and AI-powered everything on display at CES, we talked about some of the field's biggest questions.
sentences.zh: 在CES展会上展出的各种机器人、游戏系统、智能科技以及由人工智能驱动的一切当中，我们探讨了该领域的一些最大疑问。

sentences.en: How can we harness the power of artificial intelligence ethically?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能合乎道德地利用人工智能的力量？

sentences.en: Can digital health interventions help solve the mental health crisis?
sentences.zh: 数字健康干预措施能否帮助解决心理健康危机？

sentences.en: How should companies approach online privacy?
sentences.zh: 公司应如何对待在线隐私？

sentences.en: And can video games promote mental health?
sentences.zh: 电子游戏能否促进心理健康？

sentences.en: After the discussion on AI, we caught up with panelist Nathaniel Fast,
sentences.zh: 在关于人工智能的讨论结束后，我们采访了小组成员内森·法斯特，

sentences.en: director of the Neely Center for Ethical Leadership and Decision Making at the USC Marshall School of Business.
sentences.zh: 他是南加州大学马歇尔商学院尼利道德领导力和决策中心的主任。

sentences.en: Dr. Fast is an expert on technology adoption and studies how power and status influence people's decision making, how it interacts with human behavior,
sentences.zh: 法斯特博士是技术采纳领域的专家，研究权力和地位如何影响人们的决策、它如何与人类行为相互作用，

sentences.en: and how AI will shape our future.
sentences.zh: 以及人工智能将如何塑造我们的未来。

sentences.en: We talked about why people might make less ethical decisions when they're acting through AI agents, whether most of us trust AI,
sentences.zh: 我们探讨了为什么人们在通过人工智能代理行事时可能会做出不太合乎道德的决策，我们大多数人是否信任人工智能，

sentences.en: and why it's important to make sure that the potential benefits of AI flow to everyone, and not just the most privileged.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么确保人工智能的潜在益处惠及所有人，而不仅仅是最具特权的人群，是如此重要。

sentences.en: Here's our discussion.
sentences.zh: 以下是我们的讨论内容。

sentences.en: If you want to hear more from Dr. Fast and the other psychologists who spoke at CES, you can find all the talks at ces.apa.org.
sentences.zh: 如果你想收听更多来自法斯特博士以及在CES上发言的其他心理学家的访谈，可以在ces.apa.org上找到所有讲座。

sentences.en: So, Dr. Fast, I want to say thanks for joining us here at CES.
sentences.zh: 那么，法斯特博士，我想感谢你来到我们在CES的现场。

sentences.en: We're in Las Vegas at the most incredible technology show in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们现在身处拉斯维加斯，在世界上最不可思议的科技展上。

sentences.en: And you were part of a panel presentation this morning on artificial intelligence and ethics.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，你参加了关于人工智能与伦理的小组演讲。

sentences.en: And I just want to ask you a few questions coming from that and from the work that you do.
sentences.zh: 我只想结合这一点以及你所从事的工作，向你提出几个问题。

sentences.en: So, I'm wondering, as we talk about AI technologies, they're being developed at an amazingly fast pace right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想知道，当我们谈论人工智能技术时，它们目前正以惊人的速度发展。

sentences.en: And there are doom and gloom predictions out there about what AI is going to do to our lives.
sentences.zh: 关于人工智能将对我们的生活产生什么影响，外界存在着各种末日般的悲观预测。

sentences.en: But there are also people who are saying that our lives will be changed for the better.
sentences.zh: 但也有人说，我们的生活将会向更好的方向改变。

sentences.en: Where do you fall on that spectrum?
sentences.zh: 在这个光谱中，你倾向于哪一方？

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: It's great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: You know, I'll first preface it by saying I'm pretty excited about AI and where technology is going in today's world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我首先要说的是，我对人工智能以及当今世界技术的发展方向感到相当兴奋。

sentences.en: It's a very exciting time to be alive.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常令人兴奋的时代。

sentences.en: But I definitely get both sides.
sentences.zh: 但我绝对理解双方的观点。

sentences.en: I understand the people who are very concerned.
sentences.zh: 我理解那些非常担忧的人。

sentences.en: And I share a lot of the concerns that I guess those that you might say are in the Doomer camp have.
sentences.zh: 而且我也赞同你可能会说属于“末日派”的人所怀有的许多担忧。

sentences.en: I also share some of the excitement that some who might be techno-optimists have.
sentences.zh: 我也同样赞同一些技术乐观主义者所持有的部分兴奋感。

sentences.en: I think it's pretty naive to think that it's going to be one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 我认为，认为事情只会走向某一个极端是相当天真的。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think we've ever developed a powerful technology or tool that only had positive uses or negative harms for society.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为我们从未开发过一种只对社会产生积极用途或消极危害的强大技术或工具。

sentences.en: And so, for me, I think, you know, I see myself as kind of a measured optimiSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，对我来说，我认为我是一个比较温和的乐观主义者。

sentences.en: I think I'm optimistic because I think as psychologists, we know that we often get what we are looking for, the self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 我认为我是乐观的，因为作为心理学家，我们知道我们往往会得到我们所寻找的东西，也就是自我实现的预言。

sentences.en: And so, I think it really makes sense for us to be optimistic about what we can achieve as humans in response to these new technologies.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为我们对人类为应对这些新技术所能取得的成就保持乐观是非常合乎情理的。

sentences.en: But I'm very measured about it because I think that there's a lot of tremendous harms and downsides of these technologies if we don't kind of deploy them and adopt them and use and govern them effectively.
sentences.zh: 但我的态度很温和，因为我认为，如果我们不以有效的方式部署、采纳、使用和治理这些技术，它们将会带来大量巨大的危害和负面影响。

sentences.en: In your research, you look at how interacting with AI may change human behavior and the way we relate to each other.
sentences.zh: 在你的研究中，你探讨了与人工智能的交互如何改变人类行为以及我们彼此建立联系的方式。

sentences.en: For example, in one study, you looked at how using an AI assistant might actually make people behave less ethically.
sentences.zh: 例如，在一项研究中，你探讨了使用人工智能助手实际上可能会使人们的行为变得不那么合乎道德。

sentences.en: And that's what you were talking about this morning, the ethics of AI.
sentences.zh: 而这正是你今天上午在谈论的内容，即人工智能的伦理。

sentences.en: Can you talk about that study, what you did, and what did you find?
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈那项研究、你们做了什么以及发现了什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, we're actually still in the early phases of this, and we described this, I described this in a paper with John Gratch,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我们其实还处于这个领域的早期阶段，我们在一篇与约翰·格拉奇合写的论文中描述了这一点，

sentences.en: and John and his team are the ones who did that particular study.
sentences.zh: 约翰和他的团队才是进行那项具体研究的人。

sentences.en: But what we're finding overall is that we can often hide behind the AI that we're using to kind of mediate our relationships.
sentences.zh: 但我们总体的发现是，我们常常可以躲在我们用来调节人际关系的人工智能背后。

sentences.en: And so when we are face-to-face, as we are now,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们像现在这样面对面交流时，

sentences.en: there's a greater sense of kind of evolutionary pressure that I think is a positive one to kind of treat each other fairly and so on and not manipulate each other or do harm.
sentences.zh: 我认为会有一种更强烈的进化压力感——我认为这是一种积极的压力——促使我们彼此公平对待等等，而不是去操纵彼此或造成伤害。

sentences.en: But when our interactions are mediated by an AI assistant or an AI model that's negotiating on our behalf, then we can kind of hide behind that.
sentences.zh: 但当我们的互动是由代表我们进行谈判的人工智能助手或人工智能模型居中调节时，我们就可以躲在它后面。

sentences.en: And you can also think about it in terms of algorithms, like if you're hailing a ride from Lyft or Uber and the price looks a little low, you know,
sentences.zh: 你也可以从算法的角度来考虑，比如如果你用Lyft或Uber叫车，而价格看起来有点低，你知道，

sentences.en: it's a little easier to just kind of let that algorithm do its thing.
sentences.zh: 顺其自然地让算法发挥作用会稍微容易一些。

sentences.en: And it's a little bit harder for us to kind of like step in and do something about it.
sentences.zh: 而我们要想介入并采取点行动则会稍微困难一些。

sentences.en: And so I think what we were trying to say in that article was just that there's some potential for kind of moving in an unethical direction, maybe more so than we would naturally,
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为我们在那篇文章中试图表达的观点只是，随着我们越来越多地采纳人工智能，朝着不道德方向发展的潜在可能性可能会比我们顺其自然时更大，

sentences.en: the more we adopt AI.
sentences.zh: 越是采纳人工智能，这种可能性就越大。

sentences.en: Another study that I have with Roshni Ravindran and Peter Carnaval, we looked at managers and when managers,
sentences.zh: 我和罗什尼·拉文德兰以及彼得·卡纳瓦尔合作的另一项研究中，我们关注了管理者，当管理者，

sentences.en: we put managers in situations where they had to engage in kind of socially unacceptable behaviors like micromanagement and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我们将管理者置于必须从事微观管理等社会不可接受的行为的情境中时。

sentences.en: They much preferred to use virtual, you know, to manage virtually rather than in person when they were doing those types of things.
sentences.zh: 当他们做这类事情时，比起面对面，他们更倾向于使用虚拟方式来进行管理。

sentences.en: And so I think that also speaks to the psychology that we kind of hide behind these technologies in some cases.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为这也说明了一种心理学现象，即在某些情况下，我们会躲在这些技术背后。

sentences.en: Speaking of hiding behind technologies, you studied how much people trust AI, for instance,
sentences.zh: 说到躲在技术背后，你研究了人们有多信任人工智能，例如，

sentences.en: whether they'd rather be monitored at work if they're going to be monitored at work by a human or an AI system.
sentences.zh: 如果要在工作场所受到监督，他们是愿意由人类监督还是由人工智能系统监督。

sentences.en: What have you found?
sentences.zh: 你们发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣。

sentences.en: So I found kind of opposite results, but they actually make a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 我发现了可以说是相反的结果，但它们实际上非常合乎情理。

sentences.en: So across a couple of different projects.
sentences.zh: 这是在几个不同的项目中得出的。

sentences.en: So in one project with Roshni again, we actually found that people are more willing to be tracked when the tracking is done by technology only.
sentences.zh: 在与罗什尼合作的另一个项目中，我们实际上发现，当追踪仅由技术完成时，人们更愿意被追踪。

sentences.en: So if people are at work and they're going to be tracked by their computer or a smartwatch or something like that, it's kind of monitoring their performance and things like that.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果人们在工作时将受到他们的计算机、智能手表或类似设备的追踪，即监测他们的表现之类的事情，

sentences.en: They're much more willing to say yes to those situations than when those same tools are being used to track them.
sentences.zh: 他们比在用同样的工具追踪他们，

sentences.en: But there's a human who's doing analyzing the data and looking at the data and all of that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 但却有一个人类在分析数据、查看数据以及处理所有诸如此类事情的情况下，更愿意对这些情况说“好”。

sentences.en: And we found that even when we told them what the data were going to be used for and so on,
sentences.zh: 而且我们发现，即使我们告诉他们这些数据将被用来做什么等等，

sentences.en: there's something psychological that we've kind of evolved to feel kind of what we argued and found in our paper was that people feel kind of less autonomy when they're being watched by another person.
sentences.zh: 有一种我们在进化中形成的心理机制——我们在论文中论证并发现的是，当被另一个人监视时，人们会感到自主性有所降低。

sentences.en: That creates kind of a social pressure to perform and to not be judged negatively, whereas the technology doesn't judge us.
sentences.zh: 这会产生一种表现的社会压力，并避免受到负面评价，而技术不会评判我们。

sentences.en: It just kind of measures our performance.
sentences.zh: 它只是在某种程度上衡量我们的表现。

sentences.en: And so people tend to have a greater preference for that.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们往往更偏爱这种方式。

sentences.en: But in another paper with David Newman and Derek Harmon, we actually found that, you know, once we have all these data that we're collecting in the organizational context,
sentences.zh: 但在与大卫·纽曼和德里克·哈蒙合作的另一篇论文中，我们实际上发现，你知道，一旦我们收集了组织环境中的所有这些数据，

sentences.en: we can actually use them to make decisions like HR decisions, hiring and firing and promotions and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上可以用它们来做出决策，比如人力资源决策、招聘、解雇、晋升以及类似的事情。

sentences.en: And perhaps remove some of this human bias that enters into these decisions.
sentences.zh: 并且也许能消除带入这些决策中的一些人类偏见。

sentences.en: And it's one of the biggest things that employees are, you know, complain about is human bias in these decisions.
sentences.zh: 员工抱怨最多的最大问题之一就是这些决策中的人类偏见。

sentences.en: But what we found is that actually people in that case prefer humans to make the decisions.
sentences.zh: 但我们发现，实际情况是，在这种情况下，人们更喜欢由人类来做决策。

sentences.en: And so we would give them a whole set of different, you know, HR related decisions that were made.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们给他们提供了一整套不同的、你知道的、做出的与人力资源相关的决策。

sentences.en: And when we told them those same decisions were made by an algorithm and AI, they were they viewed them as less fair than when they were made by humans.
sentences.zh: 当我们告诉他们这些相同的决策是由算法和人工智能做出时，他们认为这些决策比由人类做出时更不公正。

sentences.en: And so we have this kind of juxtaposition where we're giving our data, you know, we're more willing to be tracked and provide our data, which might be problematic for privacy.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们面临着这样一种并存的局面：我们交出自己的数据，你知道，我们更愿意被追踪并提供我们的数据，这可能会对隐私造成问题。

sentences.en: Once we have that data, we could actually use it to make good decisions.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们有了这些数据，我们其实可以用它来做出好的决策。

sentences.en: But in those cases, that's when we want to step in and say we don't we don't trust it.
sentences.zh: 但在这些情况下，这正是我们想要介入并说我们不信任它的时候。

sentences.en: So it's kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以这挺有趣的。

sentences.en: But with some of these AI, with some of these HR applications of AI, because AI is basically scraping what's out there in the world and coming together and then, you know,
sentences.zh: 但对于其中一些人工智能，对于人工智能的一些人力资源应用，因为人工智能基本上是在搜罗世界上存在的东西，将其整合在一起，然后，你知道，

sentences.en: using the data to basically interpret.
sentences.zh: 利用数据来进行解释。

sentences.en: And I mean, it becomes a tool for us,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它成了我们的一个工具，

sentences.en: what I'm trying to get at is that AI can be as biased as we are, the people who create the initial data that goes into the AI.
sentences.zh: 我想表达的是，人工智能可能和我们一样带有偏见，也就是那些为人工智能输入初始数据的人。

sentences.en: And so we've seen in some HR instances where AI makes the same bias decisions that the human beings make.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在一些人力资源实例中看到，人工智能做出了与人类相同的带有偏见的决策。

sentences.en: How can we counteract that?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能抵消这一点？

sentences.en: So Amazon famously tried to create a hiring algorithm and they had to scrap it at the end.
sentences.zh: 所以，亚马逊曾出名地尝试创建一个招聘算法，但他们最终不得不废弃它。

sentences.en: They tried to overcome the bias.
sentences.zh: 他们试图克服这种偏见。

sentences.en: It kept hiring men and suggesting that they hire men and not women.
sentences.zh: 它一直录用男性，并建议他们录用男性而不是女性。

sentences.en: And and so they took names out.
sentences.zh: 因此他们去掉了姓名。

sentences.en: They took, you know, they tried to strip everything out from the resumes.
sentences.zh: 他们试图从简历中剥离所有信息。

sentences.en: But the AI is very good at assessing and knowing what's, you know,
sentences.zh: 但人工智能非常擅长评估和了解情况，你知道，

sentences.en: whether you played women's sports in college or whether you use even certain adjectives to describe your performance, that men and women differed on that.
sentences.zh: 比如你是否在大学里参加过女子体育运动，或者你是否使用了某些特定的形容词来描述你的表现，男性和女性在这方面有所不同。

sentences.en: And so they had to scrap that.
sentences.zh: 因此他们不得不废弃那个算法。

sentences.en: So in some cases, I think we actually just need to not rely on AI when we can't remove that from from the system.
sentences.zh: 所以在某些情况下，我认为当无法从系统中消除这些偏见时，我们实际上就是不应该依赖人工智能。

sentences.en: In other cases,
sentences.zh: 而在其他情况下，

sentences.en: Sindel Mullenathan and his team of researchers have this great study where they found that there was racism embedded in a decision making algorithm that was used by a hospital in a medical context.
sentences.zh: 森德尔·穆拉纳坦和他的研究团队有一项出色的研究，他们发现医疗背景下的医院所使用的一个决策算法中嵌入了种族主义。

sentences.en: And they actually did an audit of the algorithm and they were able to find that it was making decisions that were based on monetary preferences that ended up being racist decisions.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上对该算法进行了审计，并能够发现它做出的决策是基于金钱偏好的，最终变成了带有种族主义色彩的决策。

sentences.en: And they were able to go in and fix those.
sentences.zh: 而他们得以进入系统并修复了这些问题。

sentences.en: And and as Sindel talks about, you know, once you fix an algorithm, a decision making algorithm, it doesn't make that mistake anymore.
sentences.zh: 正如森德尔所说，你知道，一旦你修复了一个算法，一个决策算法，它就不会再犯同样的错误了。

sentences.en: But you can kind of tell people that they're making biased decisions and they continue to make them, you know, year after year.
sentences.zh: 但你可以告诉人们他们正在做出带有偏见的决策，而他们年复一年地继续这样做。

sentences.en: And so there is, you know, it's not as easy as just saying, let's throw it out all together or let's always use it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这并不像简单地说明“让我们彻底扔掉它”或者“让我们一直使用它”那么容易。

sentences.en: I think we have to be really smart about how we're doing this.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在如何做到这一点上必须非常聪明。

sentences.en: You know, your panel this morning was about ethics and AI,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你今天上午的小组讨论是关于伦理和人工智能的，

sentences.en: and I got to thinking about a story I had read about somebody who really wanted to be on the podcast that Esther Perel does,
sentences.zh: 这让我想起我读过的一个故事，关于一个非常想上埃丝特·佩雷尔的播客的人，

sentences.en: the psychologist who talks about relationships and works with with people actually on her podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特·佩雷尔是一位谈论人际关系并在她的播客中实际与人们一起工作的心理学家。

sentences.en: And because he couldn't quite get on the show, he created an AI Esther Perel.
sentences.zh: 由于他无法顺利上节目，他便创建了一个人工智能版的埃丝特·佩雷尔。

sentences.en: And I think we're seeing more of these kinds of things happening.
sentences.zh: 我想我们正在看到越来越多的这类事情发生。

sentences.en: I read about an AI, Marty Seligman, another psychologist, because they have a big body of work out there that can be synthesized.
sentences.zh: 我读到过关于一个人工智能马蒂·塞利格曼的报道，他是另一位心理学家，因为他们有大量可以被综合利用的著作成果。

sentences.en: Is that an ethical thing to do?
sentences.zh: 这样做符合伦理吗？

sentences.en: And, you know, if somebody wanted to make an AI of you, how would you feel about that?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果有人想做一个你的AI替身，你会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: Yeah, I well, I definitely would feel concerned.
sentences.zh: 是的，我，嗯，我绝对会感到担忧。

sentences.en: And I'm you know, that's one of the things that I'm concerned about.
sentences.zh: 而且我，你知道，这也是我所担心的事之一。

sentences.en: A lot of people are concerned about, especially as we head into the election, you know,
sentences.zh: 许多人对此感到担忧，特别是在我们迎来选举的时候，你知道，

sentences.en: with 20 to 30 seconds of a voice, a person's voice, you can actually create a deep fake that sounds just like that person.
sentences.zh: 只需20到30秒的人声，一个人的声音，你就可以实际创建一个听起来跟那个人一模一样的深度伪造（deepfake）。

sentences.en: We can do that with videos now, too.
sentences.zh: 我们现在也可以用视频做到这一点。

sentences.en: It's this is this is new territory for us.
sentences.zh: 这，这是对我们而言全新的领域。

sentences.en: We have to figure, you know, figure these things out.
sentences.zh: 我们必须弄清楚，你知道，把这些事情搞明白。

sentences.en: I certainly can't say that I'm comfortable with that idea.
sentences.zh: 我当然不能说我对这种想法感到安心。

sentences.en: I think we will find our way as a society and try to figure out how to handle those those situations.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们将以社会的身份找到出路，并试着弄清楚如何处理这些情况。

sentences.en: But it's probably going to be messy.
sentences.zh: 但这可能会是一团糟。

sentences.en: And this upcoming election is is actually going to be quite messy as well.
sentences.zh: 接下来的这场选举实际上也将相当混乱。

sentences.en: You have also talked about the need to democratize AI to make sure that the benefits get to everyone in all parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 你还谈到了将人工智能民主化的必要性，以确保福利能够惠及世界各地所有人。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: What do you mean when you say democratize AI?
sentences.zh: 你说的“将人工智能民主化”是什么意思？

sentences.en: A lot of people are talking about democratizing AI and they mean different things.
sentences.zh: 许多人都在谈论将人工智能民主化，而他们所指的意思并不相同。

sentences.en: And so I think that is exactly where we should start with that question.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这正是我们应该从这个问题开始探讨的地方。

sentences.en: And the reason why it's a big priority for me is that, you know, we live in a world where right now we're developing powerful AI systeMs.
sentences.zh: 它对我来说是一个重大优先事项的原因是，你知道，我们生活在一个当前正在开发强大人工智能系统的世界中。

sentences.en: And these AI systems are affecting the entire world.
sentences.zh: 这些人工智能系统正在影响着整个世界。

sentences.en: And not only are they affecting the entire world, but also, you know, all future humans who, you know,
sentences.zh: 它们不仅影响着整个世界，而且，你知道，所有未来的全人类，你知道，

sentences.en: who are lucky enough to walk the face of the earth are going to be affected by these systems, too.
sentences.zh: 那些有幸活在这个世上的人，也将受到这些系统的影响。

sentences.en: And they're made by such a tiny minority of the existing population in the world today.
sentences.zh: 而它们是由今天世界上现有人口中极小的一小部分人制造的。

sentences.en: So that's a problem.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个问题。

sentences.en: In my perspective, I've studied power for most of my career.
sentences.zh: 从我的角度来看，我职业生涯的大部分时间都在研究权力。

sentences.en: And that's a power imbalance if you've ever seen one.
sentences.zh: 如果你见过权力失衡的话，这就是典型的权力失衡。

sentences.en: And and so we do need to democratize AI, meaning we need better.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们确实需要将人工智能民主化，这意味着我们需要更好的东西。

sentences.en: We need to infuse the AI systems that we're building with more input from around the world.
sentences.zh: 我们需要向我们正在构建的人工智能系统中注入更多来自世界各地的意见和输入。

sentences.en: And there are different things you can democratize.
sentences.zh: 你可以将不同的东西民主化。

sentences.en: And I want to make this point here because I think big tech often talks about democratizing AI.
sentences.zh: 我想在这里提出这一点，因为我认为大型科技公司经常谈论将人工智能民主化。

sentences.en: And I don't really like the way that that they're talking about it.
sentences.zh: 而我其实并不喜欢他们谈论它的方式。

sentences.en: They mean creating cheap products that lots of people can use.
sentences.zh: 意思是创造出许多人都能使用的廉价产品。

sentences.en: And there's nothing inherently wrong with products that a lot of people can use.
sentences.zh: 大量人都能使用的产品本身并没有什么本质上的问题。

sentences.en: But in the case of something like social media, you know, making sure that it's like a free product that everybody gets to use.
sentences.zh: 但在社交媒体之类的情况下，你知道，确保它是一个每个人都能使用的免费产品。

sentences.en: And in many ways, humans are kind of the product there.
sentences.zh: 而且在很多方面，人类在那里某种程度上就成了产品。

sentences.en: I don't know that democratizing access to that is is really a positive force for good that democratizing implies.
sentences.zh: 我不认为普及这种获取途径真的是民主化所暗示的那种对社会有益的正向力量。

sentences.en: And so when I talk about democratizing AI, I'm really talking about democratizing the design of the systems,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我谈到人工智能民主化时，我实际上是在谈论系统设计的民主化，

sentences.en: democratizing the use of the systems and democratizing the governance of the systeMs.
sentences.zh: 系统使用的民主化以及系统治理的民主化。

sentences.en: And really finding ways for more people's voices to be infused into each of those those three areas.
sentences.zh: 并且真正去寻找方法，让更多人的声音融入到这三个领域的每一个当中。

sentences.en: A lot of educators worry that artificial intelligence is going to change teaching and learning for the worse
sentences.zh: 许多教育工作者担心，人工智能会让教与学变得更糟，

sentences.en: by letting a lot of students offload their writing and other work to AI chatbots.
sentences.zh: 因为这会让许多学生把写作和其他工作推给人工智能聊天机器人完成。

sentences.en: You're a professor as well as a researcher.
sentences.zh: 你既是教授也是研究人员。

sentences.en: Is this something you worry about?
sentences.zh: 这是你担心的事情吗？

sentences.en: How do you approach it in your classroom?
sentences.zh: 你在课堂上是如何处理这个问题的？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I mean, I'm not worried about it.
sentences.zh: 对，不，我是说，我不担心这个。

sentences.en: Maybe I should be.
sentences.zh: 也许我应该担心。

sentences.en: But I'm not worried about it because as long as we change how we teach, I think we're going to be OK.
sentences.zh: 但我不担心，因为只要我们改变教学方式，我认为我们就不会有问题。

sentences.en: And I actually believe we need to change how we teach.
sentences.zh: 而且我实际上认为我们需要改变教学方式。

sentences.en: I think we we've needed to change how we teach for a long, long time.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们很长很长一段时间以来都需要改变教学方式。

sentences.en: And so when we make our classrooms more experiential, when we make them more kind of exploratory,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们让课堂更具体验性，当我们让课堂更具探索性、

sentences.en: team based, things like that, I think people learn a lot more through working on projects together.
sentences.zh: 团队导向等时，我认为通过一起做项目，人们能学到更多东西。

sentences.en: And so I think AI actually lends itself really well for for students to kind of explore new tools and explore new ways of using AI.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得人工智能实际上非常适合学生去探索新工具和使用人工智能的新方法。

sentences.en: But it does require that we change and it requires that we that we both find good ways of using AI.
sentences.zh: 但这确实需要我们做出改变，需要我们找到使用人工智能的好方法。

sentences.en: And also, you know, especially when we're trying to teach writing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，特别是当我们试图教写作时。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're going to probably have to have people work on that in the classroom and flip the classroom.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们可能不得不让人们在课堂上完成这些，并进行翻转课堂。

sentences.en: If they do it at home, they're going to use chat GPT in many cases.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在家里做，在很多情况下他们会使用 ChatGPT。

sentences.en: And so, you know, but I think I think we can handle this.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，但我认为我们可以应付这一点。

sentences.en: I think we can find good ways to continue to to educate people.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以找到好方法继续教育人们。

sentences.en: Despite these concerns, AI does have the potential to transform our lives in beneficial ways as well.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些担忧，人工智能确实也有以有益的方式改变我们生活的潜力。

sentences.en: What are some of your biggest hopes for AI at this point?
sentences.zh: 目前你对人工智能最大的希望是什么？

sentences.en: There's a lot of benefits.
sentences.zh: 有很多好处。

sentences.en: And one of the another reason why it's important to kind of democratize the use of AI.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么普及人工智能的使用很重要的另一个原因。

sentences.en: And I think this comes from kind of educating and getting the word out to populations that might not otherwise get the word out is because there are benefits of AI.
sentences.zh: 我认为这来自于教育那些原本可能无法了解这一信息的人群并让他们知晓，因为人工智能确实有好处。

sentences.en: And so, like I was just recently in Kenya and was touring the Kibera slum.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像我最近在肯尼亚参观基贝拉贫民窟一样。

sentences.en: And my tour guide lives there in Kibera.
sentences.zh: 我的导游就住在基贝拉。

sentences.en: And I asked him if he had ever heard of chat GPT.
sentences.zh: 我问他是否听说过 ChatGPT。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was across the world.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我当时在世界的另一端。

sentences.en: I thought I would take advantage of the opportunity to to ask someone.
sentences.zh: 我想利用这个机会问问别人。

sentences.en: And it turns out he had and he surprised me.
sentences.zh: 结果他听说过，这让我很吃惊。

sentences.en: He had heard of chat GPT.
sentences.zh: 他听说过 ChatGPT。

sentences.en: He had heard about it from somebody from the UK who was on a tour.
sentences.zh: 他是从一个参加旅游团的英国人那里听说的。

sentences.en: And he actually uses chat GPT to increase bookings.
sentences.zh: 他实际上在利用 ChatGPT 来增加预定。

sentences.en: And he takes its advice about like how to take pictures, how to arrange his his his website and so on.
sentences.zh: 他采纳了关于如何拍照、如何布置网站等方面的建议。

sentences.en: And so I think that there's a lot of benefits that that people around the world who don't have access to great education and who don't have access to personal tutors.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，世界上许多无法获得优质教育、无法获得私人导师的人可以从中获得很多好处。

sentences.en: The way that the wealthy often do that I'm really excited about.
sentences.zh: 就像富人经常做的那样，我对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm really excited about people getting access to to good tutors.
sentences.zh: 我真的很兴奋人们能够获得好的导师。

sentences.en: And Khan Academy has created a tool that's pretty exciting as well on that front.
sentences.zh: 可汗学院在这方面也创造了一个相当令人兴奋的工具。

sentences.en: I'm also I'm also excited about the possibility that I will bring people together to address it.
sentences.zh: 我也对人工智能将人们聚集在一起解决问题的可能性感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And maybe maybe I'm a little bit like blindly optimistic about this, but I think I think that there's potential here.
sentences.zh: 也许我对这一点有点盲目乐观，但我认为这里确实有潜力。

sentences.en: And so at the Neely Center at the USC Marshall School of Business that I direct, we have something called the Neely Indices where we're tracking user experiences,
sentences.zh: 因此，在我指导的南加州大学马歇尔商学院尼利中心，我们有一个名为“尼利指数”的项目，用来追踪用户体验，

sentences.en: how are social media platforms affecting users, how are AI models affecting users, how are mixed reality technologies affecting users.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体平台如何影响用户，人工智能模型如何影响用户，混合现实技术如何影响用户。

sentences.en: One of the things that we found with AI is that both Republicans and Democrats are are concerned kind of equally across the board.
sentences.zh: 我们在人工智能方面发现的一点是，无论共和党人还是民主党人，普遍都持有同等程度的担忧。

sentences.en: They're both excited and concerned about AI to equal amounts.
sentences.zh: 他们对人工智能既兴奋又担忧，程度不相上下。

sentences.en: We haven't politicized this issue yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有把这个问题政治化。

sentences.en: Of course, we tend to politicize every big issue.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们倾向于把每个大问题都政治化。

sentences.en: And so that's a concern.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个令人担忧的地方。

sentences.en: But I think it's also an opportunity for us to kind of work together.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这也是我们携手合作的一个契机。

sentences.en: And so that's one thing I'm also hopeful about.
sentences.zh: 这也是我感到希望的一个方面。

sentences.en: One of the things that struck me that you said on the panel here at CES was that we need to slow down the development of AI.
sentences.zh: 你在 CES 的小组讨论中说过的一句话让我印象深刻，那就是我们需要放慢人工智能的发展速度。

sentences.en: Why do you think that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么这么认为？

sentences.en: And is it even possible to make business slow down?
sentences.zh: 让商业放慢脚步甚至可能吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, that's another good question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是另一个好问题。

sentences.en: And so to clarify, so there's there's a gap, which is the speed capacity gap that I mentioned.
sentences.zh: 为了澄清一下，这里存在一个差距，也就是我提到的速度能力差距。

sentences.en: And where we're deploying and developing new AI and new technologies with a greater speed than we're able to handle.
sentences.zh: 我们部署和开发新人工智能以及新技术的速度，已经超过了我们能够应对的速度。

sentences.en: And so we don't have the capacity to kind of make decisions about these new technologies.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们没有能力对这些新技术做出决策。

sentences.en: And we don't know how they're affecting us.
sentences.zh: 我们也不知道它们是如何影响我们的。

sentences.en: And so it's really hard to to govern, to set policy, to design technologies more effectively and with greater health benefits when we don't really know how they're affecting us.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们真的不知道它们如何影响我们时，很难进行治理、制定政策、更有效地设计技术并带来更大的健康效益。

sentences.en: And so, of course, you can you can close that gap by either slowing things down or speeding up the capacity.
sentences.zh: 当然，你可以通过放慢速度或提高能力来缩小这一差距。

sentences.en: And I'm actually not a big proponent of slowing things down.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我并不是放慢速度的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: I do think that one way to slow things down effectively is to hold companies more accountable for the harms that their technologies are creating.
sentences.zh: 我的确认为，有效放慢速度的方法之一是让公司对其技术造成的危害承担更多责任。

sentences.en: When we do that, they're going to go.
sentences.zh: 当我们这样做时，他们就会行动起来。

sentences.en: They're going to slow themselves down by choice because they don't want to put technologies out there too quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们会选择自行放慢速度，因为他们不想过快地推出技术。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so I think that kind of slowing down is good.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得那种放慢速度是件好事。

sentences.en: But I don't like the idea of slowing down simply to slow down.
sentences.zh: 但我不喜欢为了放慢而放慢的想法。

sentences.en: And the reason is because we learn from each iteration.
sentences.zh: 原因是我们从每一次迭代中学习。

sentences.en: And so if you think about something like large language models, each iteration of large language models as we deploy it,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你想想大型语言模型之类的事物，在我们部署大型语言模型的每一次迭代时，

sentences.en: we learn a whole bunch of stuff and that gets embedded into the next model.
sentences.zh: 我们都会学到大量的东西，而这些东西会被嵌入到下一个模型中。

sentences.en: And so if we're trying to learn as much as we possibly can by, say, the year 2030 or 2040, the more iterations that we can have in between now and then,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们试图在 2030 年或 2040 年之前尽可能多地学习，那么从现在到那个时候之间我们能进行多少次迭代，

sentences.en: the more we're going to learn and be able to create safer models.
sentences.zh: 我们就能学到越多，并能够创造出更安全的模型。

sentences.en: The caveat to that is there are times where we're kind of deploying the technology too quickly and with too much speed that we're not actually able to learn and give adequate feedback in between the iterations.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，有时我们部署技术的速度太快、速度太猛，以至于在迭代之间我们实际上无法学习并给出充足的反馈。

sentences.en: And so that's where we're really working hard to try to elevate the capacity of society.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在努力提升社会能力的领域。

sentences.en: And I think for me anyway, as an academic,
sentences.zh: 无论如何，对我来说，作为一名学者，

sentences.en: one of the best ways that we can improve society's capacity to handle the speed is actually to collect data more quickly and share it broadly.
sentences.zh: 提高社会应对速度的能力的方法之一，其实是更快地收集数据并广泛共享。

sentences.en: And so with the Neely indices, for example, we're collecting data about all the different platforms, not just one.
sentences.zh: 以尼利指数为例，我们正在收集关于所有不同平台的数据，而不仅仅是一个。

sentences.en: We're making it public so the companies feel kind of pressure and also incentives.
sentences.zh: 我们将其公开，这样公司就会感受到压力，同时也有动力。

sentences.en: You know, when they do good things, they also get credit for that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当他们做好事时，他们也会因此受到认可。

sentences.en: And then we're also sharing that with researchers so that they can actually get research out there quicker.
sentences.zh: 然后我们也与研究人员分享这些数据，以便他们能更快地发表研究成果。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm more bullish on the idea of like speeding up our capacity than I am on slowing down the tech.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，比起放慢技术发展，我更看好提升我们的能力。

sentences.en: But when it comes to punishing a developer that is doing harm, how would that happen?
sentences.zh: 但当谈到惩罚作恶的开发者时，这该如何实现呢？

sentences.en: I mean, we have watched Congress try to wrestle with social media, which I think 80 percent of them don't understand or use.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们看着国会试图应对社交媒体，而我认为其中 80% 的人并不理解或使用社交媒体。

sentences.en: And then we have organizations or regulators like the FTC.
sentences.zh: 然后我们还有诸如联邦贸易委员会之类的机构或监管机构。

sentences.en: But I mean, they're also slow on the draw as well.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，他们的反应也很慢。

sentences.en: So does the punishment just come from the marketplace?
sentences.zh: 所以惩罚仅仅来自于市场吗？

sentences.en: I think the marketplace is the best the best place for punishment to come for the companies with, you know, by not buying products and abandoning products.
sentences.zh: 我认为市场是公司受到惩罚的场所，通过不买产品和抛弃产品来实现。

sentences.en: And you see that with, you know, companies like X or Twitter, you know, and you see some of that market pressure happen as a result of decisions that the companies make.
sentences.zh: 你可以从 X 或 Twitter 等公司身上看到这一点，你会看到公司所做决策导致的一些市场压力。

sentences.en: And that's another, you know, one of the benefits of the indices that we're trying to work on through the Neely Center is making those data public.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们通过尼利中心努力推进的指数的好处之一，即公开这些数据。

sentences.en: And so, for example, you know, Twitter ranked very high on our initial sets of indices for people reporting that there was, you know,
sentences.zh: 因此，举个例子，你知道，在我们的最初几组指数中，Twitter 的排名非常高，因为人们报告说那里有，你知道的，

sentences.en: content that was bad for the world or bad for them personally.
sentences.zh: 对世界有害或对他们个人有害的内容。

sentences.en: Very and lower on kind of connecting with others or learning new things, whereas like LinkedIn, for example,
sentences.zh: 在与他人联系或学习新事物方面的得分非常低，而像 LinkedIn，例如，

sentences.en: scored very high on or decently high on learning new things and connecting with others, but really low on the harMs.
sentences.zh: 在学习新事物和与他人联系方面的得分非常高或相当高，但在危害方面的得分非常低。

sentences.en: And so that's evidence or that's data out there that's relevant to users and they can make decisions about where to spend their time.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是与用户相关且摆在明面上的证据或数据，他们可以据此决定将时间花在哪里。

sentences.en: I think one of the things that I do want to note,
sentences.zh: 我认为我确实想指出的一点是，

sentences.en: and this is really messy and a lot of people have a lot of arguments about like accelerationists are naive or maybe the people who are saying,
sentences.zh: 这非常混乱，许多人有很多争论，比如加速主义者很天真，或者那些说“我们暂停一下、放慢脚步”的人很天真。

sentences.en: let's take a pause and slow down are naive.
sentences.zh: 让我们暂停并放慢脚步的人很天真。

sentences.en: I actually think it's a messy debate, which actually is a healthy democracy.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为这是一场混乱的辩论，这恰恰是一个健康的民主社会的表现。

sentences.en: That's what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 这正是它应有的样子。

sentences.en: And so the Future of Life Institute, for example, had the big pause letter, you know, let's pause for six months, things like that.
sentences.zh: 因此，例如生命未来研究所发布了那封大型暂停信，你知道的，暂停六个月之类的。

sentences.en: And you could critique those things, but I actually think that they got the policymakers' attention.
sentences.zh: 你可以批评这些做法，但我确实认为它们引起了决策者的注意。

sentences.en: And I think when you see what policymakers and the kind of the lack of understanding of how social media was working back when they were dealing with that,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，当你看到决策者在处理社交媒体时对社交媒体运作方式的缺乏了解，

sentences.en: and you compare that to how much they understand about AI, there's a big difference.
sentences.zh: 把它与他们对人工智能的理解程度进行比较，就会发现有很大的不同。

sentences.en: They are actually a lot more skillful with regard to AI and, you know, they have room to grow.
sentences.zh: 他们在人工智能方面实际上要熟练得多，而且，你知道，他们还有成长空间。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of that is because of the concern that's been generated.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很大程度上是因为引发了人们的担忧。

sentences.en: So I think everything comes with its pros and cons, but I do want to acknowledge that I think some of those calls had the effect of getting everybody's attention.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为凡事都有利有弊，但我确实想承认，其中一些呼吁确实起到了引起所有人注意的效果。

sentences.en: And I think that's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一件好事。

sentences.en: Is there enough transparency in AI as it's developing today?
sentences.zh: 当今人工智能的发展有足够的透明度吗？

sentences.en: No, that's an easy one.
sentences.zh: 没有，这个问题很简单。

sentences.en: We need more transparency.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更多的透明度。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, the companies that are building it, I think we have to have a measure of like kind of mission, almost like missional quality to what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为，构建它的公司，我们需要对他们所做的事情有一种使命感，几乎可以说是具有使命导向的品质。

sentences.en: Like we're building AI, we're doing something that's never been done before.
sentences.zh: 就像我们正在构建人工智能，我们正在做一件从未做过的事情。

sentences.en: And so part of our mission is to be transparent about what we're building, how we're building it, what's going into the data, the training data,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的部分使命是透明地展示我们正在构建什么、我们是如何构建它的、什么被放进了数据中、训练数据是什么，

sentences.en: and maybe weighing in on some of the research findings that are out there.
sentences.zh: 并也许对现有的某些研究发现发表看法。

sentences.en: There's just a huge stream of research is not fun to try to stay on top of this field.
sentences.zh: 研究如潮水般涌来，想要紧跟这个领域的步伐可一点也不好玩。

sentences.en: It is like unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这简直难以置信。

sentences.en: And so I think if companies were more transparent about what they're doing and how they're doing it,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，如果公司对他们在做什么以及如何做能更加透明，

sentences.en: as well as like weighing in on some of the research and doing research of their own, I think we're going to be better off the more that happens.
sentences.zh: 并且对一些研究发表看法并进行他们自己的研究，我认为发生得越多，我们的情况就会越好。

sentences.en: And what are the next big questions for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，接下来的几个重大问题是什么？

sentences.en: What are you working on?
sentences.zh: 你在忙些什么？

sentences.en: I'm, you know, I'm putting a lot of effort this year into efforts to democratize AI in the way that we're talking about, getting more input from around the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，今年我投入了大量精力来实现我们刚才讨论的人工智能民主化，从世界各地获取更多意见。

sentences.en: I'll be doing a lot of international travel to talk to people who are in different areas.
sentences.zh: 我将进行大量的国际旅行，与不同地区的人们交谈。

sentences.en: We're expanding our indices to Poland, to Kenya, to Somalia, to other countries to collect more data from people who don't typically get their data into the conversations.
sentences.zh: 我们正在将指数扩展到波兰、肯尼亚、索马里和其他国家，以便从那些通常无法将数据纳入对话的人群中收集更多数据。

sentences.en: And then the second thing is really working on purpose-driven technology and trying to shift the paradigm away from kind of maximizing engagement,
sentences.zh: 第二件事是真正致力于目标驱动的技术，并试图将范式从那种最大化用户参与度、

sentences.en: maximizing profit through engagement.
sentences.zh: 通过参与度最大化利润的模式中转变出来。

sentences.en: And instead, really, you know, tech designers, but also consumers as well as policymakers thinking about purpose-driven technology.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，让技术设计者，以及消费者和决策者真正去思考目标驱动的技术。

sentences.en: What is the purpose of this particular, you know, what is the purpose of using this large language model or this VR headset?
sentences.zh: 这个特定技术的目的是什么，你知道的，使用这个大语言模型或这个 VR 头显的目的是什么？

sentences.en: What am I trying to achieve with it?
sentences.zh: 我想用它实现什么？

sentences.en: And is it achieving that purpose and, you know, measuring that?
sentences.zh: 它是否实现了这个目的，并且去衡量这一点？

sentences.en: And what are some of the side, you know, side effects or the harms that come from it?
sentences.zh: 以及它带来的副作用或危害有哪些？

sentences.en: And we do that with medicine and with new drugs.
sentences.zh: 我们在医学和新药研发上就是这么做的。

sentences.en: And I think we need to do that with a lot of these new technologies because they're getting to be quite powerful.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们需要对许多这些新技术采取这种做法，因为它们正变得相当强大。

sentences.en: And so I'll be focusing on how to shift the paradigm to focus more on purpose-driven tech.
sentences.zh: 因此，我将专注于如何转变范式，更多地关注目标驱动的技术。

sentences.en: And just to illuminate for our listeners what you mean by that, are there some examples of purpose-driven AI technologies right now?
sentences.zh: 为了向我们的听众阐明你所说的意思，现在有没有目标驱动的人工智能技术的例子？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: I mean, you can think about, like, the metaverse, all the conversations about the metaverse.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以想想元宇宙，所有关于元宇宙的讨论。

sentences.en: And you could think about virtual reality as kind of an opportunity to create a virtual space that we push people into or incentivize people into.
sentences.zh: 你可以把虚拟现实看作是一个机会，去创建一个我们把人们推向其中或激励人们进入其中的虚拟空间。

sentences.en: And they spend a bunch of time in virtual reality.
sentences.zh: 他们在虚拟现实中度过了大量时间。

sentences.en: And that's the metaverse.
sentences.zh: 这就是元宇宙。

sentences.en: It's this container.
sentences.zh: 它就是这样一个容器。

sentences.en: And we make money because we collect data from them, you know, lots of data from while they're in there, almost like a glorified social media.
sentences.zh: 我们赚钱是因为我们从他们那里收集数据，你知道的，他们在里面时的大量数据，几乎就像一个美化版的社交媒体。

sentences.en: It's unclear what the purpose of that is.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚这样做的目的是什么。

sentences.en: And so that's like a profit-driven or engagement-driven model.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是一个利润驱动或参与度驱动的模型。

sentences.en: And that's not actually working.
sentences.zh: 而且这实际上并没有奏效。

sentences.en: People are not rushing to Meta's vision of what the metaverse could be.
sentences.zh: 人们并没有蜂拥至Meta对元宇宙愿景的设想中。

sentences.en: And instead, there's so many, and we heard many of them today with the APA sessions and others, where people are using virtual reality to treat pain or to treat Parkinson's or to,
sentences.zh: 相反，有太多这样的应用，我们在今天APA和其他机构的会议上也听到了很多，人们正在利用虚拟现实来治疗疼痛、治疗帕金森病，或者

sentences.en: you know, improve learning and improve kind of optimism about the world and make a difference in the world and things like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，改善学习，增强对世界的乐观态度，改变世界以及诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: Those are very purpose-driven experiences that we can create for people.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们可以为人们创造的极具目的性的体验。

sentences.en: And I think the more we do that, I think the better off we'll be.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们做得越多，我们的境况就会越好。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Fest, I want to thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 好的，菲斯特博士，我要感谢你今天能来参加我的节目。

sentences.en: I want to thank you for being here at CES, participating in the panels that APA did today.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢你来到CES，参与APA今天举办的各种小组讨论。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: It's my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: You can find previous episodes of Speaking of Psychology on our website at www.speakingofpsychology.org or on Apple, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 您可以在我们的网站 www.speakingofpsychology.org 或在 Apple、Spotify、YouTube 以及您获取播客的任何地方收听《心理学话语》往期节目。

sentences.en: And if you like what you've heard, please subscribe and leave us a review.
sentences.zh: 如果您喜欢我们的节目，请订阅并给我们留下评论。

sentences.en: If you have comments or ideas for future podcasts, you can email us at speakingofpsychology at APA.org.
sentences.zh: 如果您对未来的播客有任何意见或想法，可以发电子邮件至 speakingofpsychology@apa.org。

sentences.zh: 《心理学话语》由莉·韦纳曼制作。

sentences.en: Our sound editor is Chris Kondayan.
sentences.zh: 我们的音效剪辑师是克里斯·孔达扬。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢收听。

sentences.en: For the American Psychological Association, I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 代表美国心理协会，我是金·米尔斯。
